data.one_liner: Flutter widgets and theme following the Yaru design language for desktop and web.
data.what_it_does: Provides a comprehensive collection of desktop-oriented Flutter widgets, a complete icon set following the Yaru design language, and custom themes for material widgets.
use_when: You are building a Flutter application targeting Linux and desktop environments.
You want your app to adopt the Ubuntu Yaru theme and styling.
avoid_when: You are building mobile-first applications that require standard Material Design or Cupertino styling.
strengths: Official Yaru theme and widget suite for Ubuntu and desktop.
Includes a complete custom icon set and font generation tooling.
weaknesses: Tied closely to the Ubuntu desktop design language.
Platform-specific dependencies might limit portability to non-desktop targets.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the yaru dependency and optionally setting up the icon font generator if you modify source SVGs.
